description_en: Modifies the cross-region backup settings of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS跨地域备份设置
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-instance-cross-backup-policy --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyInstanceCrossBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the source instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 源实例地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The policy that is used to save the cross-region backup files of the instance. Set the value to 1. The value 1 specifies that all cross-region backup files are saved
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份保存类型。当前唯一取值：1，表示每个备份都保存
parameters.name: cross_backup_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the cross-region log backup feature on the instance. Valid values:

0: disables the feature.
1: enables the feature.

You can enable the cross-region log backup feature only when the cross-region backup feature is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域日志备份开关，取值：
0：关闭
1：开启

跨地域备份总开关开启时，才能设置日志开关
parameters.name: log_backup_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the cross-region backup feature on the instance. This parameter specifies whether you can back up data and logs. Valid values:

0: disables the feature.
1: enables the feature.

Before you enable the cross-region backup feature, you must configure the CrossBackupRegion parameter
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域备份总开关（数据备份+日志备份），取值：
0：关闭
1：开启

开启跨地域备份时，必须传入目的地域ID
parameters.name: backup_enabled

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the cross-region backup files of the instance are stored
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份的目的地域ID
parameters.name: cross_backup_region

parameters.help_en: The policy that is used to retain the cross-region backup files of the instance. Set the value to 1. The value 1 specifies that the cross-region backup files of the instance are retained based on the specified retention period
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份保留方式。当前唯一取值：1，表示按时长保留
parameters.name: retent_type

parameters.help_en: The number of days for which the cross-region backup files of the instance are retained. Valid values: 7 to 1825
parameters.help_zh: 跨地域备份保留天数，取值：7~1825
parameters.name: retention

BackupEnabled.description_en:
The status of the cross-region backup feature on the instance. Valid values:

Disable
Enable
BackupEnabled.description_zh:
跨地域备份总开关，取值：
Disable：关闭
Enable：开启

CrossBackupRegion.description_en: The ID of the region in which the cross-region backup files of the instance are stored
CrossBackupRegion.description_zh: 跨地域备份的目的地域ID

CrossBackupType.description_en: The policy that is used to save the cross-region backup files of the instance. Default value: 1. The value 1 indicates that all cross-region backup files are saved
CrossBackupType.description_zh: 跨地域备份保存类型。默认值：1，表示每个备份都保存

LogBackupEnabled.description_en:
The status of the cross-region log backup feature on the instance. Valid values:

Disable
Enable
LogBackupEnabled.description_zh:
跨地域日志备份开关，取值：
Disable：关闭
Enable：开启

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the source instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html） operation to query the most recent region list
RegionId.description_zh: 源实例地域ID，可以通过接口[DescribeRegions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html）查看地域ID

RetentType.description_en: The policy that is used to retain the cross-region backup files of the instance. Default value: 1. The value 1 indicates that the cross-region backup files of the instance are retained based on the specified retention period
RetentType.description_zh: 跨地域备份保留方式。默认值：1，表示按时长保留

Retention.description_en: The number of days for which the cross-region backup files of the instance are retained. Valid values: 7 to 1825
Retention.description_zh: 跨地域备份保留天数，取值：7~1825
